For consideration, please email a copy of your CV in confidence to: Céline Chabée, Partner, celine.chabee@penderhowe.com or Oliver Kuehm, Associate Director, Executive Search, oliver.kuehm@penderhowe.com The Vice President, Medical Affairs is a newly defined executive mandate created to bring Indero's Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance (PV) functions under unified, senior physician leadership as the organization scales across a growing therapeutic and geographic footprint. This is a broader mandate than a Medical Monitoring leadership role: it carries P&L accountability for both functions, a direct hand in business development and client-facing bid defense, and a seat at the Operational Leadership Team table advising the Chief Medical & Scientific Officer (CMSO) on medical, scientific, and safety risk across the trial portfolio. As Indero's study footprint extends from North America and Europe into Asia Pacific, this role will be central to ensuring medical and safety standards scale consistently with the organization's growth. Reporting to the Executive and leading the Global, Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance function, the VP will set strategic direction for both functions - from physician resourcing and medical monitoring SOPs to PV case processing, signal detection,aggregate reporting, and regulatory inspection readiness, while safeguarding the safety of trial participants, the integrity of clinical data, and the quality of every deliverable the organization produces. Because the two functions sit at different points in a trial's lifecycle but share a single safety and quality lens, the role calls for a leader equally comfortable adjudicating a complex protocol-level medical decision and defending a PV inspection finding to a health authority. This is a global team of roughly 20 across Medical Monitoring, Pharmacovigilance, and medical project operations, with three functional leaders reporting directly to the VP. The role also carries meaningful external accountability. The VP will partner with Business Development and Proposals on RFP responses and full-service Medical Affairs engagements, participate directly in client presentations and bid defenses, and serve as the senior medical point of contact for key sponsor accounts -- work that puts the VP's scientific credibility and executive presence in front of the clients Indero is working to win and retain. This opportunity will appeal to a physician executive who has already led and scaled a Medical Monitoring or Pharmacovigilance function inside a CRO or pharmaceutical organization, who is comfortable owning a budget and revenue targets alongside patient safety and quality outcomes, and who wants a genuine seat at the table shaping Indero's next chapter of growth. Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Division Management Partner with the CMSO to develop and execute the long-term strategic vision for the Medical Affairs division, aligned with Indero's overall growth strategy and competitive positioning in the CRO marketplace. Own the operating budget and P&L for the Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance functions, ensuring financial discipline, resource optimization, and delivery against revenue and margin targets. Build short- and long-term capability roadmaps for Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance that keep pace with evolving regulatory requirements, sponsor needs, and industry best practice. Champion a culture of scientific excellence, patient safety, operational rigor, and continuous quality improvement across Medical Affairs. Represent Medical Affairs at the Operational Leadership Team level, serving as a key advisor to the CMSO on medical, scientific, and safety risk matters. Drive cross-divisional collaboration with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Scientific Affairs and Business Development to ensure integrated program delivery. Medical Monitoring Oversight Provide executive oversight of all medical monitoring activity across Indero's clinical trial portfolio, spanning multiple therapeutic areas. Ensure medical monitoring teams deliver high-quality, protocol-compliant medical oversight. Maintain and evolve Indero's medical monitoring model to meet diverse client needs and therapeutic complexity. Lead physician resourcing strategy, including hiring, training, deployment, and performance management. Ensure Medical Monitoring SOPs, work instructions, and quality standards are maintained, reviewed, and compliant with applicable regulatory guidelines. Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-risk medical monitoring issues, including protocol-related medical decisions, safety signal identification, and sponsor-facing medical disputes. Pharmacovigilance Oversight Provide strategic and operational oversight of the PV function, ensuring robust, audit-ready systems for case processing, signal detection, aggregate reporting, and regulatory submissions. Ensure the organization meets its pharmacovigilance obligations across global jurisdictions and country-specific PV legislation. Oversee preparation and quality review of aggregate safety reports to meet sponsor and regulatory deadlines with accuracy and scientific integrity. Champion the evolution of PV technology platforms and evaluate AI- and automation-driven efficiencies in signal detection, case processing, and literature monitoring. Lead the organization's readiness for PV regulatory inspections and internal audits, serving as a key spokesperson during health authority interactions related to pharmacovigilance. Partner with sponsor Medical Safety Officers and PV teams to establish and maintain transparent pharmacovigilance agreements (PVAs) and safety data exchange agreements (SDEAs). Ensure ongoing training and competency assessment of PV staff in case processing, medical coding (MedDRA), safety signal evaluation, and regulatory reporting. Business Development & Client Engagement Partner with Business Development to win new business, with particular focus on full-service Medical Affairs engagements. Participate in client presentations, bid defense meetings, and RFP responses, articulating Indero's Medical Affairs value proposition. Develop and nurture strategic client relationships, acting as the senior medical point of contact for key accounts to drive satisfaction and long-term retention. Lead development of competitive pricing models for Medical Affairs services in collaboration with Finance and Business Development, ensuring quotes reflect realistic resourcing and margin targets. Represent Indero in scientific and industry forums to build the organization's thought leadership and brand in Medical Affairs. Quality, Compliance & Regulatory Ensure all Medical Affairs activities comply with applicable regulations, Indero's Quality Management System (QMS), and sponsor requirements. Serve as executive-level signatory and accountability owner for Medical Affairs SOPs, quality plans, CAPA plans, and audit/inspection responses. Partner with Quality Assurance to define audit schedules for Medical Monitoring and PV, and to review and close audit findings in a timely, thorough manner. Monitor evolving global regulatory requirements relevant to Medical Affairs and proactively prepare the division for them. Build a quality-first culture and hold the Medical Affairs team accountable for regulatory compliance and data integrity at every level. People Leadership, Talent & Organizational Development Lead, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary Medical Affairs team. Design and implement a workforce planning strategy that anticipates staffing needs based on pipeline growth, therapeutic area expansion, and geographic diversification. Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive, high-performance culture where talent is developed, recognized, and retained. Develop and execute career pathing, succession planning, and leadership development programs to build a robust internal talent pipeline. Establish performance management frameworks and KPIs for all Medical Affairs functions, and deliver regular coaching and developmental feedback. Partner with HR on compensation benchmarking, onboarding, and retention strategy for medical and scientific talent in a competitive market. Requirements: IDEAL PROFILE Education Medical doctor (MD, DO, or equivalent international medical degree) required. Board certification in dermatology or rheumatology is an asset but not required; a strong generalist physician background is acceptable. Advanced business training (e.g., MBA) is an asset but not required. Professional Experience 12-15 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or clinical research industry, including 5-7 years in a leadership role within a CRO, pharmaceutical company, or hybrid organization. Demonstrated experience leading and scaling Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance functions. Proven track record of client engagement in a commercial, revenue-generating environment. Deep expertise in global clinical trial regulatory frameworks. Meaningful exposure to multiple therapeutic areas. Experience with health authority interactions, regulatory inspections, and audit defense. Experience managing P&L or budget responsibility. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or scaling an established Medical Affairs function. Working knowledge of PV safety databases and safety reporting automation tools. Exposure to AI-assisted technologies in medical monitoring, PV, or medical writing workflows. Published authorship of peer-reviewed scientific manuscripts or presentations at major clinical/scientific conferences. Multilingual capability or international regulatory experience. Our company: Indero has retained Pender & Howe to lead the recruitment initiative for their Vice President, Medical Affairs position. Pender & Howe is a North American talent advisory firm specializing in leadership recruitment and consulting. We partner with organizations to build high-performing leadership teams, optimize board effectiveness, and support executive career transitions. Our team of accomplished consultants brings deep industry expertise and a global perspective, delivering tailored, retained search and advisory services that help organizations attract, assess, and retain top-tier talent. We work closely with human capital leaders, governing boards, and executives, offering a consultative approach that aligns leadership with strategic business goals. With a presence in key North American cities—including Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Edmonton, Boston, and New York—we offer both local expertise and global reach. As a proud member of Kestria, the world’s largest executive search alliance, we extend our impact across 40+ countries and 90+ cities, enabling seamless talent solutions for international organizations. Pender & Howe is driven by the belief that diversity fuels innovation. We champion inclusive leadership and strategic growth, helping organizations navigate the evolving landscape of executive talent. Whether partnering with venture-backed innovators, private equity firms, or multinational enterprises, we are committed to shaping the future of leadership. For more information, visit penderhowe.com For consideration, please email a copy of your CV in confidence to: Céline Chabée, Partner, celine.chabee@penderhowe.com Oliver Kuehm, Associate Director, Executive Search, oliver.kuehm@penderhowe.com The work environment At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities. Working conditions Anywhere in North America Remote role with frequent travel Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment Competitive compensation with performance incentives and full benefits About Indero Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe. Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request. Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in North America.

This is a senior, client-facing role focused on advising startup founders and CEOs throughout the capital-raising process. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of experience across investment banking, venture capital, private equity, corporate finance, transaction advisory, or startup fundraising, with direct experience advising companies on institutional capital raises, ideally from Seed through Series C. The VP will independently lead fundraising strategy and advisory meetings, help founders strengthen their investment narrative and positioning, and provide senior-level guidance on valuation, capital structure, dilution, transaction timing, investor targeting, and fundraising strategy. This role requires strong financial judgment and the ability to evaluate companies from an investor's perspective. The VP should be comfortable identifying weaknesses in business models, KPIs, forecasts, financial narratives, valuation expectations, and investment theses, while constructively challenging founders when changes are needed. The position also involves preparing founders for investor meetings and diligence, reviewing financial models and transaction materials, and managing multiple startup engagements simultaneously across different industries and business models. This is not a junior execution role. The successful candidate must demonstrate executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to independently advise sophisticated founders, CEOs, investors, and senior executives. Responsibilities Serve as a senior client-facing advisor to startup founders and CEOs throughout the fundraising process. Independently lead fundraising strategy, advisory, and preparation meetings. Advise clients on fundraising strategy, valuation, capital structure, dilution, transaction timing, and investor targeting. Help founders refine pitch decks, investor presentations, financial narratives, and overall fundraising positioning. Evaluate companies from an investor perspective and identify weaknesses in the business model, financial story, growth assumptions, KPIs, valuation, and investment thesis. Constructively challenge founders when expectations, positioning, valuation, or fundraising strategy require improvement. Prepare founders for investor meetings, including anticipated diligence questions, objections, financial discussions, and presentation coaching. Review financial models, forecasts, valuation analyses, cap tables, and transaction materials and provide senior-level guidance. Work across a high volume of startup clients simultaneously and quickly understand different industries, business models, financing needs, and transaction dynamics. Coordinate with internal analysts and deal teams while maintaining ownership of the senior client relationship and strategic advice. Communicate complex financial and transaction concepts clearly to founders, executives, and investors. Maintain a high standard of responsiveness, professionalism, organization, and follow-through across multiple engagements. Requirements 7+ years of professional experience in investment banking, venture capital, private equity, corporate finance, transaction advisory, startup fundraising, or a closely related field. Direct experience advising startups on capital raises, ideally from Seed through Series C. Strong understanding of the venture capital fundraising process, institutional investor expectations, and transaction execution. Demonstrated experience personally leading founder, CEO, investor, board, transaction, or capital-raising meetings. Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate confidently with sophisticated founders, CEOs, investors, and senior executives. Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate naturally and persuasively with U.S.-based clients. Strong financial analysis, forecasting, valuation, and financial modeling skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Strong understanding of valuation methodologies, capital structures, cap tables, dilution, and transaction economics. Ability to review and provide senior-level guidance on financial models, forecasts, pitch decks, investor materials, and transaction documents. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate investment opportunities from an institutional investor perspective. Highly organized and capable of managing multiple clients, meetings, deliverables, and deadlines simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of client relationships in a fast-paced, remote environment. Experience working with internal analysts and deal teams while maintaining responsibility for strategic client advice. Experience at an investment bank, VC/PE fund, Big Four transaction advisory practice, startup advisory firm, or venture-backed company strongly preferred. Must be available to work Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time. Must be available to start immediately. Why The Post Oak Group The Post Oak Group delivers institutional-quality investment banking advisory with boutique-level service and direct senior involvement. We advise companies and business owners on complex financial transactions.

review_candidates.title: Verpleegkundige Longgeneeskunde Uitgelicht
review_candidates.description: Wil jij als verpleegkundige werken in het ziekenhuis en lijkt het je leuk om je verder te verdiepen in de verschillende longaandoeningen? Als verpleegkundige longgeneeskunde begeleid je patiënten tijdens hun opname, herstel of palliatieve fase. Je werkt daarbij in een fijn team, waar we met elkaar werken voor de beste kwaliteit van zorg. Dit ga je doen Als verpleegkundige longgeneeskunde coördineer je de zorg voor patiënten met verschillende longaandoeningen. Denk aan COPD, astma en longkanker of patiënten die een longoperatie hebben gehad. Je bewaakt het overzicht en bent aanspreekpunt voor patiënten en hun naasten. Je werkt samen met artsen, fysiotherapeuten, diëtisten en geestelijk verzorgers. Je voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en gebruikt klinisch redeneren om veranderingen bij patiënten op tijd te herkennen. Ook denk je mee over de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg. Hier kom je te werken Over de afdeling Je werkt op de verpleegafdeling Longziekten & Tuberculose met 30 bedden. Je zorgt voor patiënten met onder andere COPD, brede longproblematiek, longkanker en voor patiënten na een longoperatie. Ook begeleid je patiënten in de palliatieve fase. Je komt terecht in een gezellig en betrokken team van mbo- en hbo-verpleegkundigen, zorgassistenten, voedingsassistenten en secretaresses. De fijne sfeer op de afdeling vinden we belangrijk. Collega’s kennen elkaar, helpen elkaar en maken ook tijd voor gezelligheid. Jullie bespreken open wat goed gaat en wat beter kan. Zo zorgen jullie samen voor patiënten én voor elkaar. Wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Dan kan dat bijvoorbeeld via scholing of deelname aan werkgroepen. Over ons ziekenhuis Het Diak is het vertrouwde ziekenhuis in de stad en regio Utrecht. We zijn een ziekenhuis voor iedereen. We willen dat je je hier welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd voelt. In de zorg werk je elke dag samen met mensen met verschillende achtergronden en levensverhalen. Juist die verschillen maken onze zorg beter. Dit heb je in huis Je hebt oog voor wat een patiënt nodig heeft en merkt veranderingen in de gezondheid snel op. Je houdt overzicht, ook als meerdere patiënten tegelijk je aandacht vragen. Zie of hoor je iets dat belangrijk is? Dan bespreek je dat met artsen en collega’s. Je werkt graag samen en helpt een collega als dat nodig is. En andersom weet je dat je op je team kunt rekenen. Dit breng je mee Een afgeronde opleiding verpleegkunde op mbo- of hbo-niveau Minimaal één ziekenhuisstage op een klinische verpleegafdeling Ervaring met klinisch redeneren Ervaring met het uitvoeren van verpleegtechnische handelingen Dit krijg je ervoor terug Jaarcontract van 24 tot 36 uur per week (met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband). Een salaris tussen de € 3.228,- en € 4.346,- bruto per maand (FWG 45) op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget van € 750,- per jaar. Een eindejaarsuitkering en vakantietoeslag van allebei 8,33%. Een reiskostenvergoeding volgens de cao Ziekenhuizen. Reis je met het ov en woon je minimaal 10 kilometer van het werk? Dan vergoeden we je ov-kosten volledig. Extra verlofdagen of een nieuwe fiets met belastingvoordeel? Jij kiest zelf wat bij je past met ons keuzebudget. Je wettelijke verlof wordt aangevuld met 57 PBL-uren per jaar (bij een 36-urige werkweek). Deze PBL-uren zet je flexibel in, bijvoorbeeld voor extra vrije tijd wanneer het jou uitkomt. Gezellige uitjes en activiteiten georganiseerd voor en door collega's. Geen verplichting, wel gezellig. Blijf in balans met online yogalessen en ontwikkel jezelf met toegang tot trainingen via GoodHabitz. Meer weten over deze vacature? Neem gerust contact op met Frederique Smit, teammanager Longziekten & Tuberculose. Stuur een mailtje naar fsmit1@diakhuis.nl of bel contactinformatie . We helpen je graag verder met je vragen! Voordat je in dienst komt heb je een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) nodig en vragen we naar twee referenties. Het Diakonessenhuis is al ruim 180 jaar het vertrouwde ziekenhuis in de stad en regio Utrecht. In ons ziekenhuis gaan we voor zorg...
